newsitem.title: USA: Employee to set up captive insurance co.
newsitem.headline: Employee to set up captive insurance co.

text.p: Employee Solutions Inc said Thursday its has reached an agreement with Legion Insurance to provide a risk management/workers' compensation program for 2,300 leased employees of ESI's Logistics Personnel Corp unit.
ESI said it is in the process of forming a new captive insurance subsidiary in Hawaii for the Legion program.

"Our agreement with Legion enables us to market an additional, flexible risk management/workers' compensation option to achieve our goal of providing the broadest coverage at the most competitive rates to our clients across the United States," said Marvin Brody, chairman and chief executive officer of Employee Solutions.
Employee Solutions is a national staff leasing company.
